corrections.visual_confusable_pair: ወተፈደመ ምላሽ አጣ -> ወተፈደመ⟫ ምላሽ አጣ
corrections.reason: Tag boundary fix: 'ወተፈደመ' is the canonical Ge'ez Gospel text (Matt 22:12), while 'ምላሽ አጣ' is the Amharic Andemta translation.

Visual lookalike between 'ያ' and 'ዳ': the printed glyph has the closed loop of 'ዳ' (4th order ዳ) forming the canonical Ge'ez citation 'ዳኑ ከመ ምህረ ንስሐሁ' ('they were saved as having learned his repentance').
Vowel-order misread: the printed character clearly shows the 2nd order right-side stroke of 'ሁ' ('ንስሐሁ', 'his repentance'), not 1st order 'ሀ'.
